purpose: The OPtran transient that settles a capacitor-only node commits device state at every step; none of it may reach the analysis, which starts at t = 0 with the timer unfired.

oracle.derivation: VAMS-2023 5.10.3.3 and 4.5.8: with per = 0.3 us, lvl toggles at 0.3, 0.6 and 0.9 us, and transition(lvl, 0, 100 ns) slews V(out) linearly over the 100 ns after each fire (R1 fixes V(out); C1 and C2 only float fl). If OPtran's 1 us of fires leaked into the transient, lvl would start at 1 with the next fire at 1.2 us, and V(out) would read 1 throughout these samples.
